/-- A monad with a stateful metavariable context, defining `getMCtx` and `modifyMCtx`. -/
class MonadMCtx (m : Type → Type) where
  getMCtx    : m MetavarContext
  modifyMCtx : (MetavarContext → MetavarContext) → m Unit
